questions.q: 20 boys have a mean mark of 60 and 30 girls have a mean mark of 70. Find the mean mark of all 50 students.
questions.why: (20 × 60 + 30 × 70) ÷ 50 = 3300 ÷ 50 = 66; don't just average the two means.

questions.q: A data set contains one extreme value. Which average is most suitable?
questions.why: The median is not affected by extreme values.
